response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically diverse individual contributor with deep experience in developer tools, testing frameworks, and CI/CD infrastructure, but his resume shows no evidence of people management or team leadership responsibilities. Every role listed is an IC title (Software Developer, Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Founder as solo developer), with no mention of managing reports, conducting performance reviews, or leading organizational change, all of which are core, non-negotiable requirements for this management role.
strengths: Extensive experience building developer tools, test frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts), and CI infrastructure
Broad technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems with 15+ years experience
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and mentoring-adjacent activities (Refactoring Dojos, courses)
concerns: No evidence of formal people management experience (no direct reports, hiring, or performance management mentioned)
No indication of leading organizational change or cross-team strategic alignment at a management level
Career trajectory is consistently IC-focused (Staff/Senior Engineer titles) rather than progressing toward leadership/management roles

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools & testing infrastructure background
